representative_players: Chamika Karunaratne, Keshav Maharaj, Rahul Chahar, Shoriful Islam, Harshit Rana
strengths: Can contribute in non-pressure match phases where field restrictions or match tempo permit accumulation.
weaknesses: Negative or near-zero strike rate delta under pressure; high dot-ball accumulation (>40%); low boundary generation.
distinguishing_characteristics: Negative strike-rate delta (decline under pressure) and dot balls exceeding 40%.
potential_tactical_role: High liability in high-pressure chases; scouting consideration suggests minimizing exposure to high-pressure death phases.

representative_players: Najibullah Zadran, Tristan Stubbs, Mahendra Singh Dhoni, Sikandar Raza, Akeal Hosein
strengths: High pressure scoring velocity (>180 SR), substantial clutch acceleration over baseline (+45 to +85 delta), high boundary frequency (>25%), low dot-ball rate.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on high-risk boundary striking; aggressive intent can result in dismissals against disciplined wide-yorker execution.
distinguishing_characteristics: High scoring rate (>180 SR) paired with +40+ strike-rate elevation over baseline under pressure.
potential_tactical_role: Candidate profile for late-innings finishing roles (#5–#7); high-impact boundary acceleration during death overs.
